author: Syrian Observatory for Human Rights

content_variants.text:
Third massacre in 2022 | Eight killed and over 29 Injured in rocket attack on Al-Bab market

Aleppo province: Syrian Observatory sources have reported that the death toll of the intensive rocket attack that hit a market and populated neighbourhoods in Al-Bab city has risen to eight, including at least five civilians.

The death toll is likely to rise due to the presence of some people who sustained serious injuries and reports of other deaths.

It is worth noting that this is the third massacre in Syria since the beginning of 2022.

SOHR activists have just reported that intensive rockets hit a market and populated neighbourhoods in Al-Bab city which is controlled by Turkish forces and National Army factions in the eastern countryside of Aleppo, killing four civilians and injuring at least 22 others.

A few hours ago, SOHR activists reported intensive rocket fire by Turkish forces in the early hours of Wednesday morning.

According to SOHR sources, Turkish forces fired more than 40 rocket and artillery shells in areas of Al-Sheikh Issa, Samuqah, Harbil and Sad Al-Shuhaba where Kurdish forces were stationed north of Aleppo.
